title: Complete Niagara Falls Afterdark with Fireworks Cruise
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Unfortunately due to the nature of this tour it is not suitable for guests with mobility impairments or with wheelchairs.
Sites on this tour are subject to occasional closures. If modifications are needed and time permits, we will reach out to you prior to your tour.

Walks and Devour comply with all local government regulations. Please refer to local government guidelines for the most up to date information. This tour is located in Canada, any guest arriving from the US will need a passport to enter Canada.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience Niagara Falls after dark on this immersive Niagara Falls night tour, combining Journey Behind the Falls, a guided illuminated walk, and a rare once-nightly 40-minute Fireworks Cruise. With pre-reserved tickets included, you’ll skip ticket lines and maximize your evening exploring the falls from multiple perspectives—behind the cascading water, along the glowing waterfront, and finally from the heart of the river itself. Timed perfectly with Niagara’s nightly illumination and seasonal fireworks display, this tour is crafted for travelers who want more than a standard viewpoint. With expert storytelling and seamless coordination throughout, you’ll experience Niagara’s top highlights in one unforgettable evening.
